name: USGS Volcano Notification Service alert levels (HANS)
short: Current US volcano alert level and aviation colour code by volcano. Free, no key, US public domain.
summary: The USGS Volcano Hazards Program's HANS public API lists US volcanoes at elevated alert (getCapElevated) and all monitored volcanoes with their current alert level and aviation colour code (getMonitoredVolcanoes), with the observatory, coordinates, last notice time and synopsis. On 2026-11-08 getCapElevated returned two volcanoes, including Great Sitkin (WATCH, ORANGE) with a notice published 2026-11-07 stating that slow lava eruption within the summit crater continues.

regions: United States: Alaska, Cascades, Hawaii, Yellowstone, Long Valley and others monitored by USGS observatories
coverage.notes: Only volcanoes monitored by USGS observatories (Alaska, Cascades, Hawaii, California, Yellowstone, Northern Mariana Islands).

delivery.basis: Live GET 2026-11-08: newest elevated notice published 2026-11-07; notices are event-driven.

latency.notes: Notices are issued on status change and in periodic updates; quiet volcanoes keep notices that are years old.

freshness.typical_age: Minutes to hours after a status change
freshness.notes: Notices are issued on status change and in periodic updates; quiet volcanoes keep notices that are years old.

licensing.summary: USGS-authored data and information are in the U.S. Public Domain per the USGS copyrights page, except some third-party images; credit to USGS is requested. No terms for the HANS API itself were found beyond that page. Alert levels are expert judgements and can change without notice. AI training is not specifically addressed.
